project_info.title: Village Legends — Modern Anime Fantasy RPG
aesthetic_principles: Modern high-resolution anime fantasy visual language — NEVER pixel art
Cinematic dark navy backgrounds (#0B0F19, #111827) with translucent glassmorphic panels
Filigree gold borders (#F59E0B, #D97706, #78350F) and glowing metallic accents
Magical energy accents: Emerald Green for stamina/healing, Mana Blue for skills/magic, Crimson Red for bosses/crit damage, Radiant Gold for rare loot & progression
Ornate fantasy headlines (Cinzel / Cormorant Garamond / Trajan typography) paired with clean geometric body text (Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans)
High visual density with tactile combat HUDs, floating damage indicators, particle trails, and interactive animations

components: Brand Logo with animated glowing crest
Profile / Username display with current level badge
Quick stats HUD (Coins count, XP progress bar, Health/Mana quick view)
Tab Navigation: World Map, Heroes, Inventory, Quest Board, Shop, Settings

hero_card_features: 10 distinct playable heroes: Knight, Archmage, Shadow Blade, Paladin, Elementalist, Berserker, Celestial Cleric, Dragon Ranger, Necromancer, Wind Monk
Class icon, Base Stats radar chart / bars (ATK, DEF, MAG, SPD, CRIT)

turn_based_battle_screen.battle_layout: Full-screen chapter background with hero on left, enemy/boss on right
top_hud: Player HP/MP bars + portrait + status effects
Enemy/Boss HP bar with danger meter for boss rage
Chapter title and fight number indicator (e.g., Chapter 3 - Battle 4/5)
combat_controls_bottom: Attack: Standard strike with critical hit chance
Skill: Skill wheel with MP costs & cooldown counters
Potion: Health / Mana / Buff flask shortcuts
Defend: Shield up to halve incoming damage for 1 turn
Escape: Attempt tactical retreat with chance based on SPD stat
vfx_and_animations: Floating damage numbers (Yellow for Normal, Red/Gold with zoom scale for CRIT, Green for Heal, Blue for MP)
Screen shake on big hits or boss ultimate attacks
Attack movement step-forward animation using CSS transforms
Flash overlay effect on skill triggers and enemy counterattacks
Defeat fade-out vs Victory burst particle bounce

features: Full stats breakdown: Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Endurance, Critical Rate, Critical Damage, Dodge Chance
XP progress bar towards Level 50
Unallocated Stat Points allocator (+ / - buttons)
Class specialization mastery tree preview
Equipment slots: Weapon, Armor, Helmet, Accessory
Grid inventory (4x6 slots) with color-coded item rarities: Common (Gray), Rare (Blue), Epic (Purple), Legendary (Gold)
Item stat tooltip hover showing comparison vs equipped item
Equip, Unequip, Sell, Upgrade mechanics
Merchant NPC portrait with anime flavor text dialog
Potions stock (Small/Medium/Large HP & MP, Elixirs)
Equipment gear rotation refreshable with coins
Buyback tab & instant item purchase feedback toast
Side quest cards (Daily bounties, Kill targets, Boss slaying, Collectibles)
Rewards listing (Coins, XP, Rare Gear Crate)
Claim reward CTA button with sparkling particle shine
Master Music / SFX volume sliders
Animation speed toggle (1x, 1.5x, 2x)
Screen Shake toggle switch
VFX Flash reduction mode switch
Data reset / Hard wipe with double confirmation modal

motion_and_effects.screen_shake_css: @keyframes screenShake { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 20% { transform: translate(-8px, 6px); } 40% { transform: translate(8px, -6px); } 60% { transform: translate(-6px, -4px); } 80% { transform: translate(6px, 4px); } }
motion_and_effects.hit_impact_css: @keyframes hitImpact { 0% { filter: brightness(1) drop-shadow(0 0 0 red); } 50% { filter: brightness(2.5) drop-shadow(0 0 25px red); transform: scale(1.08); } 100% { filter: brightness(1); transform: scale(1); } }
motion_and_effects.damage_float_css: @keyframes damageFloat { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0) scale(0.6); } 20% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-20px) scale(1.3); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-60px) scale(1); } }

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, skill icons, inputs, hero cards, level nodes, equip slots, and modal close triggers MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts ('Cinzel' and 'Outfit') in public/index.html or top-level CSS.
Ensure all progress (heroes unlocked, level, current chapter, inventory, coins, stats, quests completed, sound settings) persists seamlessly in browser localStorage.
Ensure the combat system supports turn order calculations based on hero speed vs enemy speed.
Implement clear floating damage text indicators and screen shake effect triggered on critical attacks.
Never use pixel art graphics; rely on the provided high-res artwork, Tailwind gradients, translucent glass frames, Lucide icons, and ambient CSS magic effects.
Include full testid coverage on all game controls and navigation links as outlined.
